blocks.html:
Natural ventilation for bathrooms and toilet rooms may not be through openings from another room or space.
   Exception: A bathroom or toilet room may open onto a partially enclosed balcony or space above a setback conforming with Exception 2 of Section 1203.5.1.2.2.
